biss-mnev-gluing.title: Biss's matroid Grassmannian proof, Mnëv's objection and the author's erratum
biss-mnev-gluing.scope: The invalid inference from a contractible open set and a closed piece homotopy equivalent to its intersection to contractibility of their union. The erratum invalidates the proof; it does not disprove the main theorem.
biss-mnev-gluing.reuse: Public mathematical facts and failure mechanism; independently authored extraction, not a reproduction of the historic paper or an empirical difficulty claim.

navier-stokes-estimate-alignment.title: Bastounis, Circelli and Hansen: Navier–Stokes lost in translation; source Lean estimate
navier-stokes-estimate-alignment.scope: A reported difference between the m+4 input-derivative bound in a written intermediate estimate and an m+5 Lean bound. This does not refute the original estimate or the Navier–Stokes theorem; a different valid proof is legitimate.

weak-lemma-repair.title: Voevodsky's Cohomological theory of presheaves with transfers and the corrected MVW argument
weak-lemma-repair.version: CohTh Propositions 4.23-4.24, printed p.34; MVW final author notes December 2005 (book published 2006), Propositions/Lemmas 11.1 and 22.9-22.12, printed pp.83 and 185-187; Voevodsky 2014 historical account
weak-lemma-repair.scope: MVW Lemma 22.10 expressly corrects CohTh 4.23 by allowing U⊂U0 while retaining S=U∪V. The extracted target is the actual semilocal sheafification comparison in CohTh 4.24 / MVW 22.12. The reference proves the application using precise external geometric inputs and cofinal shrinking; it does not reconstruct all standard-triple geometry or supply a geometric counterexample to the old lemma.
weak-lemma-repair.reuse: Independently written task and expanded application argument on the original geometric objects. Direct applicable use of the known main lemma is an accepted short solution. No empirical difficulty claim.
